fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Mitch's Western road trip of gifting", "body": "Mitch described an eleven day drive through Utah, Montana, Idaho and Nevada to bury orgonite earth pipes near cell towers, with about 1,500 pipes loaded into a rental car. He argued that wildflowers growing out of rocks showed the summer drought story was untrue, and he said rain followed their stops in several towns. A friend who joined the live call described gifting along the Colorado River from Granby to Grand Junction with her son, plus a sharp temperature drop she saw after burying pipes. Chance added his own story of a plane crossing the sun at the 2017 eclipse."}, {"title": "Fear, targeting and strange emails", "body": "Mitch said everyone alive is a targeted individual and asked listeners to stop emailing him to ask whether he was afraid. Chance added that fear works like consent, and he argued that energy, frequency and vibration are the only things that are real. Mitch also described the odd messages that followed his earlier appearance, including bribe offers and a stranger who wanted control of his social media. Chance joked about being pitched by ball shaving companies. The mood stayed playful, and Mitch urged everyone to approach the work with a light heart."}, {"title": "Orgone as life force in plants", "body": "Chance responded to a chat comment and said Wilhelm Reich chose the word orgone because he saw it as the same charge people feel in sexual energy, adding that libido was a good gauge of being in flow. Mitch said the wildflower boom he saw on the road was mostly sunflowers, and he described feeling small bursts of wind when he watered his own sunflowers, which he compared to hosing down a chem buster. He also suggested a sprouting test with and without pipes nearby, and expected plants to grow faster."}, {"title": "Smoke, wildfires and old world tracks", "body": "Mitch argued that the haze his group saw across the West was electrified smog, not real smoke, pointing to how it cleared overnight and how rain followed after pipes were buried. Chance linked the West Coast fires to a talk with his most recent guest about how cities were destroyed in earlier resets. Chance also suggested railroad tracks fell on ley lines and were unburied rather than built, and Mitch said tracks worked as antennas, adding that he was not urging anyone to break the law."}, {"title": "Practical tips and listener questions", "body": "Mitch listed sources of metal shavings, including locksmiths and brake repair shops, and joked that people should say it was a science project. He answered listener questions about double terminated Herkimer diamonds and pipes that move, saying budget crystals work fine and a moving pipe still helps. He described ether damming and urged people near Lake Mead to join in. Chance explained that he offers remote sound healing, pulled oracle cards for Mitch and the friend on the call, and played a video from Snake Jones."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Mitch the Orgone Donor returns to share war stories from the battle against deadly orgone radiation technology. Expect some ridiculous stuff and come charged up for laughs.
